content:
**Withered Radeye** is a type of fish in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Burning Springs* update. 

Walleyes, along with other fish, used to be native to Grafton Lake. [1] 

A regional fish that can be caught with Bait - Common. When eaten, it gives two Rads and restores a total of 20 Hit Points over 25 seconds. It can alternatively be sold, displayed on a Curved Fish Display or Fish Display Plaque, or cooked into Fish Bits.

| Materials: | | Requirements: | | Produces: | 
| Withered Radeye (1) | | **Built or Scrapped:** | | Fish Bits (2) | 

Can be caught from any fishing spot in Burning Springs.
